anchors.1: No evidence against the criterion was recorded.
anchors.2: The evidence was limited to a single example.
anchors.3: The evidence covered the criterion with a clear example.
anchors.4: The evidence covered the criterion with more than one clear example.

adjustment_prompts: Please tell us if you need a change to the interview arrangements so you can take part. You do not need to tell us about your health.
note_taking: Record what the candidate said about the criterion.
Use the same anchors for every candidate.
Do not record a conclusion about a protected characteristic.
